arguments.hindsight: The handover grip was insecure, and the broom's sweeping orientation was not established well enough. I should have secured the receiving grasp, held the dustpan steady from the start, and aligned the brush and all blocks with its opening before sweeping.
arguments.reason: The blocks remain outside the dustpan, and there are too few control turns left to recover and return both arms home.
